name: gallery-push
title: Gallery wall push-in
description: A wall of photo columns unrolls from the middle while the camera pushes in.

props.name: images
props.doc: Pictures, as paths under public/ (or full URLs). They repeat when there are fewer than the count.

props.name: columns
props.doc: How many columns are in the wall.

props.name: tilesPerColumn
props.doc: How many photographs stack in each column.

props.name: columnWidth
props.doc: Width of a column, in px.

props.name: gap
props.doc: Space between tiles, in px.

props.name: depth
props.doc: How far alternate columns stand off the plane, in px.

props.name: perspective
props.doc: Camera perspective distance, in px.

props.name: openStart
props.doc: Frame the middle column starts to open.

props.name: openStagger
props.doc: Frames between one column starting to open and the next, outward from the middle.

props.name: openFrames
props.doc: Frames a column takes to open.

props.name: pushStart
props.doc: Frame the camera push starts.

props.name: pushFrames
props.doc: Frames the push takes, eased in and out.

props.name: pushTo
props.doc: How far the camera starts back from the wall, in px; it ends about a third of that distance in front of it.

props.name: motionBlur
props.doc: Camera motion blur shutter in frames, used while the camera moves fast. 0 turns it off.

props.name: turn
props.doc: How far the wall is turned at the start, in degrees; it comes square as the camera pushes in.

props.name: drift
props.doc: How far alternate columns slide, in px, over the shot.

props.name: seed
props.doc: Seed for the tile heights. Same seed, same wall.

props.name: title
props.doc: Title at the bottom left, over the wall. Empty for none.

props.name: caption
props.doc: Smaller line under the title. Empty for none.

props.name: font
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the label.

props.name: serif
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the title (italic).

props.name: colors.ground
props.doc: Background.

props.name: colors.ink
props.doc: Title.

props.name: colors.muted
props.doc: Caption.
